reason: An observability plugin that records tool and skill usage, audits the skill catalog, tracks agent health, raises error-spike alerts, and displays live operational metrics in a browser dashboard.

summaries.zh: 用于记录工具与技能使用情况、审计技能目录、监控智能体健康状态并通过浏览器仪表板展示运行指标的观测插件。
summaries.en: An observability plugin that records tool and skill usage, audits the skill catalog, monitors agent health, and displays operational metrics in a browser dashboard.

capabilities: Records real tool executions and outcomes
Aggregates daily tool and skill usage
Audits the skill catalog for metadata warnings
Tracks agent errors, status, uptime, and running agents
Triggers watchdog alerts when agent errors exceed a configured threshold
Provides a live browser dashboard for observability data
